duration.text: The MBA at Communication University of China is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5416 USD/per year ￥ 39000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 8 or above 6.Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should be less than 35 2.Applicant should hold Bachelor's degree 3.HSK level 8 or above 4.Applicants for degree study must participate in the entrance examination that is stipulated by CUC.
